findings.title: Reflected XSS on /page endpoint
findings.description: The 'name' GET parameter on /page is reflected without proper sanitization in the HTML value attribute, allowing reflected XSS. Breaking out of the value attribute with a quote and injecting an onfocus event handler with autofocus triggers execution.

reproduction.expected: Response contains alert('XSS') execution and reveals the flag
